mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, d.dept_name AS company_name FROM vi_price_rule r LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=r.owner_dept_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT dept_id,status,del_flag FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision),0) FROM vi_price_rule WHERE rule_key=#{key}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_event_log WHERE aggregate_type='VI_PRICE_RULE' AND aggregate_id=#{id} AND actor_realm='ADMIN' AND actor_user_id=#{userId} AND action IN ('PRICE_CREATE','PRICE_UPDATE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type=#{type} AND dict_value=#{code} AND status='0'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_station s JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=s.dept_id AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0' WHERE s.id=#{stationId} AND s.enabled=1 AND 1=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept company WHERE company.status='0' AND company.del_flag='0' AND company.dept_id IN #{id} AND (company.dept_id=d.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(company.dept_id,d.ancestors)>0))
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_price_rule SET config_json=#{row.configJson},config_hash=#{row.configHash}, effective_from=#{row.effectiveFrom,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, effective_to=#{row.effectiveTo,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, approved_hash=NULL,approved_by=NULL,published_at=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE vi_price_rule SET status=#{row.status},submitted_by=#{row.submittedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, approved_by=#{row.approvedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT},approved_hash=#{row.approvedHash,jdbcType=CHAR}, published_at=#{row.publishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{row.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
